goal: Add a standalone PawnShop addon that advertises a buy service on World and provides fail-closed AUX-backed whisper appraisals for BoE green equipment and Trade Goods, with GUI-editable pricing percentages and no automatic trade actions.
notes: Stage 1 only: no trade-window automation and no automatic gold placement. BoE green appraisal uses AuxVmangos' current DE material economics plus trusted vendor values with seller-share/vendor-floor/DE-cap controls. Trade Goods use AUX historical value with a configurable haircut and minimum history samples. /pawn exposes the pricing percentages and World advertising interval/toggle; settings persist in PawnShopDB.
